map.：h = 1.01·t + 0.001·d·(2500+1.84·t)，单位 k: : h = 1.01·t + 0.001·d·(2500+1.84·t), in kJ/kg dry air, where 1.01 is dry-air constant-pressure specific heat, 2500 is the latent heat of vaporization of water at 0°C, and 1.84 is water-vapor constant-pressure specific heat.
